RECYCLING EQUIPMENT TANGLERS
No plastic bags, film wrapping, holiday lights, wire, electronics, or bubble
wrap.
NON-CONTAINER PLASTICS
No toys, plastic or metal hangers, packing peanuts, garden hoses, plasticware.
CONTAMINANTS
No food waste, pizza boxes, garbage, Styrofoam®, diapers, mirrors, windowpanes,
ceramic containers, yard waste, tires, or any item not listed on the acceptable
recycling list.

INSIDE THE CART & LEAVE IT LOOSE!
All recyclables must be loose in the cart. Bagged recyclables are
not sorted and plastic bags get tangled in the sorting
equipment causing recycling to shut down.
ARE YOU A WISH CYCLER?
Don’t toss questionable items in the recycling cart, hoping they can
somehow be recycled. Recycle only the items listed on this card!
